create.name: Maude Hirst
create.bio:
Maude Hirst is a meditation teacher from East London who first made her name as an actor, best known as Helga in the television series Vikings. A hard stretch in her own life, when a relationship, a long acting job and her home all changed at once, led her to yoga and meditation, and she went on to train in meditation, yoga, intuitive movement and energy healing. She founded EnergyRise to make meditation feel approachable for people who think it isn't for them.

Her teaching is warm, informal and down to earth: short guided practices, breath work, gentle movement and honest talk about the ups and downs of ordinary life, with an emphasis on listening to intuition. She leads a weekly live meditation class online, an online community of members from many countries, an annual new-year meditation challenge and residential retreats in the English countryside, and she mentors clients one to one. She also trains new teachers through a twelve-week online course in intuitive meditation and energy healing. Her Intuitive Whispers Oracle, a 44-card deck published by Hay House in 2024, grew out of the same focus on inner guidance, and she has recorded a ten-day self-love meditation series for Commune.

books.title: Intuitive Whispers Oracle: A 44-Card Deck and Guidebook
books.author: Maude Hirst
books.description: A 44-card oracle deck with a guidebook, illustrated by Lori Menna and published by Hay House. The cards fall into four suits that move from listening and clearing towards trusting inner guidance.

courses.title: Live Online Meditation Class
courses.description: A thirty-minute meditation class on Zoom every Monday evening at 9pm UK time, booked one class at a time. Breath and gentle movement lead into stillness to start the week calmly.

courses.title: Level 1 and 2 Meditation and Energy Healing Training
courses.description: A twelve-week online teacher training, about fifty hours in all, for people who want to teach intuitive meditation and energy healing in their own voice. An optional in-person retreat gives time to practise teaching in a group; places start with a short call.
courses.price: £3,333 GBP in full or 3 × £1,111 GBP (founding price; £3,500 GBP after New Year)

courses.title: Sussex Members Retreat at Florence House
courses.description: A two-night group retreat at Florence House near Seaford, on the edge of the South Downs. Days include meditation, workshops, mindful movement and cliff-top walks by the sea.
courses.price: Members £550–£625 GBP, non-members £600–£675 GBP by room type (£150 GBP deposit)

courses.title: Mindful Mentorship
courses.description: One-to-one hour-long sessions combining mindfulness tools and energy work, shaped around the person's goals for work, relationships and direction. Available as single sessions or packages of four, six or twelve.
courses.price: £250 GBP per session; packages from £920 GBP

free_resources.title: Beginners meditation workshop
free_resources.description: A free recorded workshop of about forty-five minutes on her YouTube channel introducing the basics of sitting practice. A good first step for anyone new to meditation.

Much of her own marketing is framed around conditions: the Members Club for the Mind ('disconnect from anxiety', 'rebuild your sleep'), the EnergyRise app (stress and anxiety, sleep), a 'Back to School Anxiety Toolkit', a 'Meditation for ADHD' page, the Teachable course and the home page ('feeling anxious, not sleeping'). All left out; what remains (weekly class, teacher training, retreat, mentorship, oracle deck, general YouTube meditations) is clean. A human should decide whether she is 'mainly' condition-framed; I judged not.
Tier: Instagram following (295K) likely owes a lot to her acting career (Vikings). The rule sums followers, so luminary.
Email maude@maudehirstyoga.com is a visible 'book a FREE chat here!' mailto link on her home page (the contact page itself uses a form).
Only one photo confirmed (YouTube avatar headshot); site images are text graphics or Instagram reel stills.
Teacher training runs April to June 2027 but the page gives no exact dates, so it's undated.
She has trained in Theta Healing (named on her About page); not mentioned by name in the bio.
She appears as a guest on Scott Schwenk's podcast (rank 16 in this sprint); no shared listing.
